Ariane: Heads-up: after the NCCL 2.21 push to eu-central-3 this morning were seeing deterministic p2p failures on a specific HW revision (rack set s12).
Devon: Ok which stack exactly did we deploy?
Ariane: CUDA 12.1, nvidia driver 545.23, kernel 6.1.12, NCCL 2.21.0 from our curated image. Prior stable was 2.20 + driver 535.* + kernel 5.15.
Marta: Symptoms? hangs, slowdowns, or crashes?
Ariane: Short version: collectives initially use NVLink/p2p but then drop to proxy. Jobs see long pauses (~30-60s) then NCCL_TIMEOUTs. Example logs: 
```
[0] NCCL INFO Comm 0x8f3a : AllReduce started
[0] NCCL WARN : p2p send failed, falling back to proxy
[0] NCCL ERROR : ncclAllReduce timeout after 60 s
```
Priya: Is the problem confined to s12?
Ariane: Yes — s12 (new procurement with NVLink fw 1.5.1) shows >100 p2p errors in the last 3h. Older racks s3/s4 (fw 1.4.0) are fine.
Leo: Any link-level errors on the NVSwitch? CRC/transaction counters?
Ariane: NVLink error counter increments correlate with the first proxy fallback. PCIe counters unchanged. I captured nvlink counters and dmesg to /tmp/nccl_inc_2124/
Devon: Quick mitigation: can we force proxy globally via NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 or NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=1?
Marta: Yes but proxy adds ~1.8x token latency for our 8x A100 configs. For some endpoints thats unacceptable.
Ariane: We tested setting NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 per-cluster — collectives complete reliably but tail latency spikes.
Priya: Have we tried downgrading NCCL on a canary?
Marta: Spun up 6 canary nodes on s12 with NCCL 2.20 and same driver/kernel. Results: p2p errors dropped by ~85% but not eliminated.
Devon: That suggests a two-factor interaction: NCCL change + NVLink firmware/board revision.
Leo: Opened internal incident INC-2124 and vendor ticket NV-39411. ops-bot created the channels.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2124 created by Leo. Priority: P2. Notified #incidents #eng-runtime #eng-infra.
vendor-bot: Vendor ticket NV-39411 created; requesting nvlink counters, kernel trace, and core dumps.
Ariane: Repro steps I used (short):
```
git checkout release/bench
python bench_allreduce.py --gpus 8 --iters 200 --batch 512 --backend nccl
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO ./run_bench.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/run.log
```
Marta: In the canary run we see proxy at iteration ~42 repeatedly on s12. On older racks iteration >150 before any fallback. Almost deterministic.
Priya: Any correlating network activity? switch errors?
Ariane: Switch fabric metrics look clean (no drops), but NVSwitch internal link errors increment. We'll attach nvlink hw dump.
Devon: Immediate plan: 1) Drain s12 from new allocations (in flight jobs finish) 2) Route latency-sensitive traffic to eu-west and us-west 3) Canary rollback NCCL to 2.20 on a tiny subset for deeper profiling.
Leo: Also: ask vendor if there's a known NCCL 2.21 change that touches NVLink memory registration or p2p rendezvous semantics.
Marta: Created runtime toggle to set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE for jobs tagged low-latency:off in eu-central-3 so customers can opt-out until we fix.
Ariane: Captured kernel perf traces (ftrace/nvhost) and nvlink dumps: /var/artifacts/INC-2124.tar.gz. Also grabbed strace of stalled process.
Devon: Cost note: proxy fallback increases GPU utilization and job duration; finance flagged potential short-term cost delta if this persists.
Priya: Vendor response: they asked for PCIe ordering tables and NVLink fw blob. Also asked us to try a patch build of NCCL 2.21.1 they prepared.
Leo: Test matrix: run vendor patch on one s12 rack, run vendor patch on s3 (old fw), and run 2.20 on s12. Need to isolate whether fw+nccl combination or driver/kernel interaction.
Marta: I'll schedule the vendor-patch canary tonight and post results. If patch fails we'll do a wider NCCL rollback.
Ariane: Note: no GPU hangs or driver oops yet — just timeouts and proxy fallbacks. That reduces blast radius but still unacceptable for SLAs.
Leo: Great work. Keep logs in the incident thread and escalate if customer impact climbs. We'll avoid broad rollouts until we have a clear root cause.
Marta: Update incoming in ~45m after the first vendor-patch canary run.
ops-bot: INC-2124 updated: vendor patch scheduled.
vendor-bot: Vendor patch build 2.21.1-candidate uploaded.
Leo: Thanks. Team, keep this thread for all technical updates.
